# Nothing Firmware

> Live CMF & Nothing OS Firmware Update Tracker. Instant changelogs, version details, and step-by-step guides.

Nothing Firmware is an independent, real-time community database built by Rohit Kumar to monitor the software lifecycle of Nothing Technology and CMF products. 

## Core Focus & Features
- **Real-Time Release Tracking:** Instant alerts for public build rollouts, version indicators, and software info logs.
- **OS Firmware & System Apps:** Tracks core Nothing OS updates alongside component system applications (e.g., Nothing X, Essential Space, Nothing Gallery).
- **Comprehensive Changelogs:** Provides exact version details, release dates, visual banners, and device-specific update paths.
